channel.description: The complete audiobook of The Portal Opens by Shareef Ali Rashada, in 63 chapters: the untold story of Jesus, Lucifer's rebellion, the confession of Caligastia, Adam and Eve's message to humanity, and the lessons of Machiventa Melchizedek. Winner of the Literary Titan Silver Book Award. Read along free at https://peopleoftheworld.net/read.html
